data.one_liner: Umbrella Flutter plugin for Google's standalone ML Kit APIs.
data.what_it_does: Groups multiple Vision, Natural Language, and GenAI standalone ML Kit plugins under a single package. It allows Flutter applications to use Google's on-device machine learning capabilities via platform channels. Note that the documentation advises depending on individual packages rather than this umbrella package in production.
use_when: You want to quickly prototype multiple ML Kit features during early development.
You need on-device machine learning features like barcode scanning, face detection, or text recognition.
avoid_when: You are building a production app (the README explicitly states: DO NOT USE google_ml_kit in a production app; instead, depend directly on individual plugin packages).
You want to avoid increasing your app size with unused ML dependencies.
You need web or non-mobile platforms support.
strengths: Provides a single convenient package to access a wide array of ML Kit features during prototyping.
Covers multiple domains including Vision, Natural Language, and GenAI APIs.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms for most features.
weaknesses: Significantly increases app size because it includes all exported plugins and dependencies.
Not recommended for production use, requiring manual migration to individual packages later.
GenAI features have limited Android device compatibility and lack iOS support.
data.setup_notes: Requires mobile configuration for Android and iOS. GenAI APIs require devices with AICore support. iOS minimum deployment target is 15.0.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_text_recognition
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick individual standalone plugins instead of the umbrella package to avoid bloated app sizes in production.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_selfie_segmentation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows targeting a specific standalone ML Kit feature rather than pulling in all vision, natural language, and GenAI packages.
